title: Metal Tub — Lean Improvement
summary: Analyzed waste and process improvement opportunities in a metal-tub production exercise.
challenge: Identify non-value-added activities and practical improvement opportunities.
approach: Used value stream mapping, spaghetti diagrams, visual management, 5S, Poka-Yoke, and A3/PDSA thinking.
outcome: Developed improvement proposals; numerical outcomes have not been verified.
learned: Visualizing the current state makes improvement opportunities easier to prioritize.
